description: Assembly source code for ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R interrupt service routine (ISR) wrapper functions, handling dynamic interrupts with parameters, context switching, and nested interrupt management within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: _isr_wrapper
methods.description: Assembly wrapper for handling interrupts, demuxing ISR table, saving context, and managing nested interrupts.

methods.name: z_arm_cortex_ar_exit_exc
